description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Aranea (Lightning)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Aranea (Lightning)
description.text: Increases [Lightning Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Aranea after using two Lightning abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Air Superiority+
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (1.05 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spearouette Storm+
description.text: Four single ranged jump attacks (1.10 each), grants [Jump Instant Cast 1] to user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Aranea
description.text: One single ranged jump attack (3.36) capped at 99999, grants [Quick Cast 3] to self/[Weakness +30% Boost 3] to party is 0-3/4+ XV allies are alive

description.name: Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
